best_for: Programmers on a recent machine with a decent GPU who want a fast native editor and bring their own AI keys or agents.

points.title: Free with your own AI keys
points.text: The Personal plan costs nothing and allows unlimited use with your own API keys from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama and others, or with outside agents such as Claude Agent and Codex CLI.

points.title: Pro is for hosted AI
points.text: Pro is listed at USD 10 per month with a 14-day trial. It adds Zed-hosted models, unlimited edit predictions and USD 5 of tokens a month, then bills usage at list price plus 10 percent. Business is USD 30 per seat a month. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Needs a real GPU
points.text: On Windows Zed needs a DirectX 11 graphics card; on Linux it needs Vulkan. Inside virtual machines it runs but can be slow.

points.title: Usage data on by default
points.text: Zed sends usage metrics and crash reports unless you set `metrics` and `diagnostics` to false under `telemetry` in settings. AI and collaboration features always send the server data they need to work.

points.title: Linux: script over Flatpak
points.text: Zed's own install script is the main route on Linux. The Flatpak listed here is a community build that Flathub does not mark as verified, and Zed notes such packages may lag behind.

points.title: Per-user Windows, few versions
points.text: The Windows installer is per-user for x64 and Arm64, and the Windows listing keeps 5 versions. macOS (Intel and Apple silicon, macOS 12 and later) and Linux list only the current release.
